create_Conv2d_upsample: create a Conv2d layer with upsampling enabled for StyleGAN2-style image upscaling
create_Conv2d_downsample: create a Conv2d layer with downsampling enabled for StyleGAN2-style image downscaling
run_naive_upsample_2d: run naive_upsample_2d to upsample a PyTorch tensor by repeating pixels with a given factor
run_naive_downsample_2d: run naive_downsample_2d to downsample a PyTorch tensor by averaging pixel blocks with a given factor
run_upsample_conv_2d: run upsample_conv_2d to fuse upsampling and convolution on a tensor with an FIR filter
